harden fleet-waker smoke wake counting and gamma check Context: countWakesBySid anchors to the '- sid=X agent=' wake-line shape so a
reply echoing a sid is not counted; all wake counts read full tmux
scrollback; gamma re-confirms zero wakes for a fixed 10s after its band
drops; summon prompts use smoke.AGENTS; tests use the real band format a

bound fleet-waker no-early-wake window by real grace Context: The beta early-wake poll used 20000*timeoutScale ms, which outlives
fleet-waker's fixed 30s GRACE_MS at --timeout-scale 2 and misreported a
legitimate post-grace wake as early. noEarlyWakeWindowMs caps it at the
remaining grace minus a margin (unscaled); the failure evidence now

fleet-waker smoke waits for ready input before each summon Context: waitForInputReady dismisses open dialogs (isDialogOpen) and waits out an
active turn (isBusy) before alpha/beta/gamma summon prompts; isPromptRow
accepts placeholder rows. Read is allowed in the spawned session so a wake
turn's outbox Read never opens a permission dialog.

end sentinel poll when the pane dies; reset stale Tail offsets Context: pollSentinel only checked liveness after its full timeout, so a runner whose
pane was killed (advisor-terminate / close-worker-tab) kept polling for up to
5 minutes as an orphan. It now takes a checkAlive probe per tick.
Tail now detects a rewritten/shrunk file and resets its off

  blanked by a later tier-less summon), which activates the dormant
  TIER_BUDGETS tool budget and tier-filtered skills
- meta.json records the model resolved from --intelligence
- stdout JSON carries taskPr

drop prose/tag false positives; surface manual shell tests Context: Strip XML-ish tags, trailing punctuation and :LINE suffixes; skip $VAR/ and ~/
paths (reported separately), globs, and slash-joined prose whose first segment
is not a repo directory. On this session's six real briefs, nonexistent-path
hits fall from 109 to 12 (all genuinely absen

live cost for unaccrued sessions; make bare advisor-cost-backfill read-only Context: advisor-cost --sid now computes cost from the transcript without persisting
when no token-usage row exists, and says so explicitly when no telemetry is
found. advisor-cost-backfill needs --all or --sid to write; bare and --help
print usage only.

refuse empty --bar-ref before any summon; exclude .advisor-loop/ from git Context: An existing but empty --bar-ref (e.g. mktemp) for prior-round/--refine passed
validateBarFlags and launched a real builder worker. It now exits 6 before
runLoop. A real-run also idempotently adds .advisor-loop/ to the target repo's
info/exclude (via git-common-dir, fail-open).

the surfacing machinery — listDue() and the SessionStart 14-day banner — keys
entirely off due_date. Any lesson written by the automated path was therefore
born invisible to review, permanently.

which repo actually owned the worktree. For a worker summoned against an
external repo that removal silently failed — stderr goe

this session a doc-agent edited the live tree on master and reverted an
unrelated uncommitted file to satisfy a diff-scope chec
